London Mayor Sadiq Khan Fined for Unregistered Vehicle

London Mayor Sadiq Khan has been convicted of failing to tax a vehicle. The conviction stems from a penalty notice issued for a car that Khan claims he does not own. Khan stated he has been "scammed" and that the fine was issued incorrectly. He was reportedly fined for the unregistered vehicle, which he asserts is not his property. The specific details of the vehicle and the circumstances of the fine were not elaborated upon in the coverage.
